metaDescription: Private corporate agentic AI training in Singapore for teams of 15 to 20. Three days on your workflows, SkillsFuture-funded with Temasek Polytechnic.

answers.question: What is Nexius Academy's corporate AI training?
answers.answer: Nexius Academy runs private, company-only cohorts of its 3-day Agentic AI-Driven Business Innovation for Productivity course (TGS-2026063558) with Temasek Polytechnic, for Singapore teams of 15 to 20 per class. Master Trainer Melverick Ng and co-trainer Darryl Wong build the examples and exercises around your own workflows, so your team practises on the work it already does. No coding or prior AI course is needed.

answers.question: Who is it for?
answers.answer: Companies that want to train one team or several departments together, instead of sending individuals to a public class. It suits operations, finance, HR, compliance, sales, service and support teams with repetitive or review-heavy work. Managers, team leads and frontline staff can learn in the same cohort, so everyone leaves with one shared standard for using AI. It is built for non-technical teams.

answers.question: What will our team leave with?
answers.answer: After three days, your team leaves with: a phased agentic AI roadmap; a map of where agents can help across HR, Finance, Operations and Customer Support, using your own workflows; human-agent workflow designs with clear roles and review points; practical governance controls for use, data and review; and an executable action plan with one shared review standard. Participants with at least 75% attendance who attempt the assessment receive a Certificate of Completion.

answers.question: How many people can attend a company class?
answers.answer: A dedicated company class takes a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 20 participants per class. If you have fewer than 15 people, they can join a public intake of the same 3-day course instead.

answers.question: How long is it, what format, and where?
answers.answer: Three full days, 9am to 6pm, in person and hands-on (24 hours in total). You choose the dates: the three days can run back to back or be split, for example two days, a practice gap, then day three. We deliver at your office, or at an external training venue such as Lifelong Learning Institute, Paya Lebar.

answers.question: Can company training be funded through SkillsFuture?
answers.answer: Yes. Every private company cohort is run with Temasek Polytechnic and goes through SkillsFuture funding (course code TGS-2026063558). The SkillsFuture-subsidised fee per learner is S$190.50 for Singapore Citizens aged 40 and above or eligible SME-sponsored learners, and S$490.50 for Singapore Citizens below 40, Singapore PRs and LTVP+ holders. The full course fee before funding is S$1,635.00. Fees per learner include 9% GST and are subject to final learner eligibility, funding approval and registration confirmation.

answers.question: How much does corporate AI training cost?
answers.answer: The overall price for a company cohort is quoted on request, by arrangement with Melverick Ng. It depends on your team size, preferred dates, venue and how much tailoring you need. Per-learner fees follow the SkillsFuture-subsidised fee rows on this page. Request a proposal, and after a short advisory call we send you a recommended structure with pricing.

answers.question: How do we enquire, and what happens next?
answers.answer: Click Request Proposal, or email hello@nexiuslabs.com with the subject "Dedicated Company Class Enquiry". An enquiry does not reserve a place.

enquiryAnswer: Submitting an enquiry or subsidy check on the Nexius Academy website does not reserve a class seat or confirm admission; your seat is confirmed only after completing the official Temasek Polytechnic STEP registration before the intake deadline (6 November 2026 for the 3-day course). Self-sponsored learners register directly via the official individual STEP link using Singpass, complete payment, and submit any SkillsFuture Credit claim via MySkillsFuture. Company-sponsored learners must first have their company's authorised Corppass administrator sign in via the official Company Corppass Admin link, declare SME or non-SME status, generate a unique company-sponsored registration link for the employee, and approve the employee's submitted application under Pending verification before the link expires. Learners who complete the programme receive a Certificate of Completion (requiring at least 75% attendance and passing the assessment for the 2-day Foundations course, or at least 75% attendance and attempting the assessment for the 3-day Business Innovation course).

remaining.question: Can the workshop focus on our real internal workflows?
remaining.answer: Yes. The company-run format is specifically designed to make the workshop more relevant to your team's actual use cases, recurring tasks, and process pain points.

remaining.question: Can you run the training at our office?
remaining.answer: Yes. We deliver at your office, or at an external training venue such as Lifelong Learning Institute, Paya Lebar.

remaining.question: Is this suitable for non-technical teams?
remaining.answer: Yes. The course is designed for non-technical professionals and focuses on practical workflow use, not coding.

remaining.question: Can leaders and frontline staff attend together?
remaining.answer: Yes. In many cases that works well because it helps the organisation align on use cases, governance, and realistic implementation steps.
